comments.author: michaelmanly
comments.text:
I tested n8n's actual fallback classifier on the error shape reported here. An HTTP 500 with the `InternalServerError` / `'role'` body did not select Chat Completions fallback, while a tested `unknown_url` control did.

Function-level reproduction: https://aibadgr.com/evidence/n8n-40924-responses-500-does-not-fall-back-to-chat-completions

This was **not** an end-to-end n8n agent test, and I haven't verified that Badgr AI API resolves this particular integration yet. I'm building Badgr's AI API routing/validation layer and would be interested in testing the exact endpoint behavior with you. If we can establish a working route, I can offer $5 in eligible trial credits for a real agent workflow. Would that be useful?
